notes.title: Adding Japanese Language Support
notes.notes: Japanese language support has been added.

notes.title: Added Support for GamePads
notes.notes: Now you can also play the game using your favorite GamePad!

notes.title: Support for Apple Silicon computers added!
notes.notes:
The game is now also playable on Apple Silicon computers!

Enjoy it now on your PC, Mac or Linux! 

Have fun!

notes.title: Achievements have finally arrived!
notes.notes:
The wait is over!

Achievements have finally arrived to Day of the Dead: Solitaire Collection!

Now you can have even more fun by unlocking the 24 totally unique achievements!

Are you ready for the task?

And now the game also supports the Portuguese-Brazilian and Chinese Languages!

notes.title: Storm Tale 2 is Here!
notes.notes:
We’re pleased to announce the premier Steam release of [b]Storm Tale 2[/b]. 

Sharpen your sword and take up your bow - it’s time to fight back a powerful sorcerer and his mighty dragon. Join Griffri, the wizard, on a quest to not only rebuild his village, but to put an end to the perilous reign of evil that threatens the realm. Play bonus mini-games with cool 3D hidden object scenes and jigsaw puzzles. Beat the obstacles and win many trophies on your journey through this addictive match 3 game. Bring the peace back to this fabulous land. Are you ready for an adventure?

[previewyoutube=kceH-IDe7Pg;full][/previewyoutube]

Check it out! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588940/Storm_Tale_2/
